newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Coceral sees 16.4 mln tns soft wheat exports in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Coceral sees 16.4 mln tns soft wheat exports in 1996/97.

text.p: European Union exports of soft wheat and flour will total 16.4 million tonnes in 1996/97 (July/June), up from 12.1 million tonnes in 1995/96, Coceral, the EU grain trade lobby forecast.
According to figures obtained on Tuesday, exports of barley and malt were seen rising to 7.7 million tonnes, from 4.5 million over the same period.
The EU's grain export prospects were discussed at a meeting on Thursday of the EU's cereals advisory committee, made up of EU Commission trade and producer representatives.
Up until February 7, the EU exported seven million tonnes of wheat grain and 4.3 million tonnes of wheat eqvivalent in flour.
For the rest of the season ending on June 30, Coceral saw another four million tonnes of wheat grain exports and around 1.1 million tonnes of wheat equivalent in flour.
The EU exported four million tonnes of barley and 2.7 million tonnes of malt until February 7.
Another one million tonnes of barley exports are targeted by the end of the season.
